fusions.name: Sawn-Off Snort
fusions.desc: Blasts a cone of shot 2.5 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it.

fusions.name: Stockyard Mercy
fusions.desc: Fires a point-blank bolt that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Warning Shot
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. While it lasts, an escort of piercing fights beside you, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Held Fire
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
